metadata.title: fix(security): Harden HTTP Responses and Outbound Requests
metadata.author: kevalmahajan

description:
## Summary

Harden output encoding and URL validation across HTTP response paths.

- Apply `html.escape()` to user-controlled fields in HTTP responses (user IDs, session IDs, error messages, host headers, database-sourced names)
- Add `SecurityValidator.validate_url()` before outbound HTTP requests in the LLM proxy service

### Files changed

- `mcpgateway/routers/llmchat_router.py`
- `mcpgateway/routers/toolops_router.py`
- `mcpgateway/routers/reverse_proxy.py`
- `mcpgateway/routers/observability.py`
- `mcpgateway/services/llm_proxy_service.py`
- `scripts/demo_a2a_agent_auth.py`

commits.message:
fix(security): remove incorrect html.escape from JSON APIs, add host header tests

Remove html.escape() calls from JSON API response fields and
HTTPException details — these are application/json responses, not HTML,
so html.escape mutates data without preventing XSS. Keep the two
legitimate fixes: SecurityValidator.validate_url() for SSRF protection
in llm_proxy_service and Host header regex validation in
demo_a2a_agent_auth.

Add parametrized tests for host header validation covering valid
hosts, XSS payloads, path traversal, and malformed inputs.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(tests): expand SSRF regression tests with multiple vectors

Parametrize SSRF tests across cloud metadata (169.254.169.254),
bind-all (0.0.0.0), localhost (127.0.0.1), and RFC 1918 private IPs
(10.0.0.1) for both streaming and non-streaming paths. Tests for
localhost/private IPs override the relaxed test defaults to exercise
strict SSRF protection.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
